scope: Robustness: explicit degradation on malformed or degenerate input, verified rather than assumed
why: CASE.md scores robustness (устойчивость) and the project's own brief requires a clear degradation or an explicit refusal on bad input, never a silent wrong answer

temporal_cases.gap beyond frame_max_gap_s: gap_reset set, motion reason reports the gap

reading: every degenerate input produces an explicit status, reason and health rather than an exception or a quiet decision, and both temporal failure modes are handled explicitly. This is a tested property of the shipped recipe, and it is the behaviour an evaluator probing the container would see
